installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt -y update
apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl unzip lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates wget

cd /mnt/server

if [ "$STARTUP_OS" = "./samp03svr" ]; then
  curl -sSL -o samp.tar.gz http://sa-mp.co.id/files/samp037svr_R2-2-1.tar.gz
  mkdir -p /mnt/server
  tar -xzvf samp.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/
  cp -r /mnt/server/samp03/* /mnt/server
  rm -rf /mnt/server/samp03/
  sed -i '3d' /mnt/server/server.cfg
  echo "rcon_password changemeplease" >> /mnt/server/server.cfg
elif [ "$STARTUP_OS" = "wine64 ./samp-server.exe" ]; then
  curl -SL -o samp.zip https://sa-mp.co.id/files/samp037_svr_R2-2-1_win32.zip
  unzip -o -d /mnt/server/ samp.zip
rm -rf samp.zip
fi

chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
